environment.description: Same Lambda function code deployed as a container image running on EKS Fargate (AWS managed Kubernetes). The pod runs in namespace 'partner-integrations' with a sidecar envoy proxy handling all egress. Namespace has a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy object (apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1) with spec.podSelector matching label app=config-fetcher, spec.policyTypes=['Egress'], and a single egress rule allowing traffic only to CIDRs 0.0.0.0/0 EXCEPT with an explicit deny via Calico GlobalNetworkPolicy (order: 100) targeting 169.254.0.0/16 on all ports. The Calico policy uses a namespaceSelector matching kubernetes.io/metadata.name=partner-integrations. Note: the standard Kubernetes NetworkPolicy does not support deny rules natively - the Calico CNI extension is required. EKS Fargate profiles do not support Calico CNI; the cluster uses EKS managed node groups with Calico Enterprise 3.17 installed via operator. IRSA (IAM Roles for Service Accounts) is configured with a condition key limiting the pod's token audience.
